text: Got the Aurora X2s last week at $149. For that price I was expecting the usual generic garbage but these actually exceed most people's expectations. I think the most impressive bit is the ANC. It does a remarkable job of blocking noise on my daily commute. The sound itself is also exceptional, super clear highs and deep resonant bass. The companion app will disconnect a few times, and if you listen a ton, the ear cushions will make your ears sore. And the battery is 30 hours or so. Not the reason I bought them. But I would tell anyone who wants a pair of reliable headphones to go ahead and get these.
